top_findings.title: Every HTTP request returns 404: handler dispatches on cowboy_req:path_info, which is undefined for these routes
top_findings.evidence: src/books_api_app.erl:6 compiles exact routes "/health", "/books", "/books/:id" (no [...] segment); cowboy 2.12 cowboy_router.erl:386 list_match([],[],B) -> {true,B,undefined}. Re-verified by calling cowboy_router:match/3 on this exact dispatch: /health, /books, /books/1 all -> {ok,h,[],_,undefined,undefined} (PathInfo=undefined). src/books_api_handler.erl:7 reads path_info and every route/3 clause (lines 13-34) matches a token list, so all requests hit the catch-all at src/books_api_handler.erl:35 -> 404. Affects R1-R6, R8, R9, R10.
top_findings.suggestion: Use cowboy_req:path(Req) split on '/' (or cowboy_req:binding(id, Req) plus per-route State), or declare routes with [...] so path_info is populated.

top_findings.title: No test exercises the HTTP layer, so a 100%-404 server passes test_coverage=1.0
top_findings.evidence: test/books_api_tests.erl:4-34 — the 3 tests call only books_api_handler:validate/1 and books_api_store directly; no test starts cowboy or calls init/2/route/3
top_findings.suggestion: Add at least one integration test that starts the app and issues GET /health and a POST/GET /books round-trip.
